[[File:AgamarianBeast.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An Agamarian beast]]
This '''beast''' was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] animal present on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. It was a quadruped, with a thick tail and bone protrusions rising from a flared crest at the rear of its head. The Agamarian beast ate only [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Tree/Legends|trees]].

During her voyage to Agamar to warn [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] rode one of these beasts.
